title: Manifest kind folder scope is now resolved per served version, not coalesced
answers: Can different versions of the same manifest kind have different folderScoped settings?
Why did my app plugin's folder requirement get overridden by another version?
Is there a check preventing a new version from losing folder-scope enforcement?
body: Previously kindstore.FolderScopedResources OR-folded folderScoped across every served version of an app-plugin manifest kind because all versions shared one GroupResource-keyed storage-options registration; a later version declaring folderScoped:false was silently overridden by an earlier version requiring it. That function is deleted. Now pkg/services/apiserver/kindstore/store.go:New scopes folder support/RequireFolder into the per-GVK StorageOptions via opts.StorageOptsGetter, so each version keeps the scope it declares. Constraint/caveat: folder scope governs RBAC inheritance; tightening (adding folder requirement) in a newer version is safe, but loosening (dropping it) is not detected or blocked automatically — there is no startup check yet that flags a served version loosening folder scope relative to another version of the same kind.
applies: App-plugin manifest kinds (kindstore) served under multiple API versions with differing folderScoped declarations
says: Different manifest versions should allow different folder scope requirements

search: Manifest kind folder scope is now resolved per served version via StorageOptions in pkg/services/apiserver/kindstore/store.go:New (not coalesced across versions like the deleted FolderScopedResources function). Each GVK keeps the folderScoped scope it declares through opts.StorageOptsGetter; a later version's folderScoped:false no longer overrides an earlier version's requirement. Folder scope governs RBAC inheritance, so tightening it (adding requirement) in a newer version is safe, but loosening it is not detected or blocked automatically at startup. Caveat: there is no automatic check flagging when a served version loosens folder scope relative to another version of the same kind. Applies to app-plugin manifest kinds served under multiple API versions with differing folderScoped declarations.
